notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.3 SR10: "Data-name-1, data-name-2, data-name-3, data-name-4, and data-name-5 must be unique within a CD entry." For an output CD, CommunicationSectionBinder.ReadClauses records each of DESTINATION COUNT, TEXT LENGTH, STATUS KEY, ERROR KEY and SYMBOLIC DESTINATION through its local Record, which refuses a name another field of the entry carries with COBOL6169 quoting SR10 ("within a CD entry") at 85; a series of data-names and FILLER are refused for Format 2, which prints neither. Probes at 85: STATUS KEY = TEXT LENGTH (the witness), SYMBOLIC DESTINATION = DESTINATION COUNT, ERROR KEY = TEXT LENGTH under DESTINATION TABLE OCCURS 2 INDEXED BY DX, a lower-case repeat, and a repeat without the table each refused; five distinct names accepted and run (MOVE 2 TO DC prints 0002); an index-name reused as ERROR KEY is a different user-word kind (COBOL2692).

next.reason: 1985: "Data-name-1, data-name-2, data-name-3, data-name-4, and data-name-5 must be unique within a CD entry."; 2023: "No communication module or CD entry; no candidate from the feature's clauses, and none by wording covers a CD entry.". 2023 has no communication description entry, so this rule on unique data-names in a CD entry has no counterpart. The wording candidates concern unrelated entries.
